do.text: Leave `cellEdit` off a column that is worked out from others, so it follows every edit and refuses a paste.

dont.text: Don't store a total and make it writable: change the quantity and the total is wrong.

title: Show what is not saved yet

do.text: Mark unsaved cells with `cellStatus` and their rows with `rowStatus` until the save lands.

dont.text: Don't keep unsaved edits looking like saved ones: nobody can tell what a save will write.
